question: A masonry structure has a load-bearing wall with a thickness of 225 mm. If the compressive strength of the masonry is 5 N/mm², what is the maximum allowable load on the wall using the formula: P = (f x A)/4?

A reinforced concrete slab has a thickness of 100 mm and a span of 3 m. If the concrete has a compressive strength of 30 N/mm² and the steel reinforcement has a yield strength of 400 N/mm², what is the ultimate load capacity of the slab?
An electrical installation has a circuit with a voltage rating of 240 V and a current rating of 10 A. What is the maximum allowable power rating of the circuit using the formula: P = V x I?
A building has a fire-resistance rating of 2 hours. What does this rating imply in terms of fire safety?
options: The building can withstand fire for at least 3 hours without collapsing or spreading the fire to adjacent areas
The building can withstand fire for at least 4 hours without collapsing or spreading the fire to adjacent areas
The building can withstand fire for at least 1 hour without collapsing or spreading the fire to adjacent areas
The building can withstand fire for at least 2 hours without collapsing or spreading the fire to adjacent areas
